blocks.text:
Breakfast at the hotel; Transfer to the airport, flight to Foz de Iguacu, where you will be picked up and taken to your hotel.

Iguazú is a system of 275 waterfalls stretching for nearly 3 kilometres. The falls are linked to ancient volcanic activity and the basalt plateau. You can feel the humidity as you approach the national park and hear the roar of the water before reaching the main viewpoints.

The next two days are devoted to different sides of the falls. The Brazilian side gives you a view of the whole system, while the paths and boardwalks on the Argentine side take you much closer to individual cascades.

The change of scene is striking after Carnival at night and several days in the city. Here the humid forest, the rush of the river and the constant spray set the scene. Photographs can hardly convey the scale of Iguazú: the cascades stretch for nearly 3 kilometres, and the view changes at every turn along the trail. That is why the itinerary allows three nights at the falls.
